manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Classify the latest visible image-only 修学支援 PDF as publication lag rather than a non-target candidate.
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index disclosure URL registered for the school.
Open the public report page and inspect the 修学支援 links.
Follow the anchor R7修学支援に関する資料 to 09_shugakushien_r7.pdf.
Treat the PDF as latest-public old-year target-form evidence for target FY2026 because the URL and anchor identify R7, not R8.

reusable_rules: Keep image-only 修学支援 PDFs visible in evidence even when strict target-year extraction cannot accept them.
When URL or anchor explicitly says R7/令和7 for target FY2026, classify the school as publication_lag_latest_public.
Surface this as an operator publication-lag state, not as non-target noise.
anti_patterns: Do not count an R7 image-only support PDF as FY2026 success.
Do not classify strong 修学支援 old-year hints as non-target just because the PDF text is image-only.
Do not treat generic MEXT boilerplate years such as 2020年度対象 as publication-lag evidence.
